Hellooooooooo Everyooooooone!!

I hope you are having a wonderful day!! Alongside my long running comics that I do like Winds of Change, I have decided to start making short comics. I've released a couple here before, but they will probably come a bit more often now, every few months or so! Today's comic is Midas Touch, as you can probably tell it's going to be a story like the one of King Midas, but with a gender bending twist! I hope you enjoy it!! These short comics are just a little bit of fun and nothing serious like my longer more in depth comics... But I hope you enjoy them all the same!!

To see more of my comics head to Patreon.com/maideneir
